top.line: Odoo 20 agents can write to the system of record; here is how our stack fits around Odoo.
top.para: Policies per agent, an Odoo cell, plan-then-apply through a vault, and a SHarness showcase.

in-short.line: Odoo agents write; the assist-to-execute line; RiskMandate, AgentiCCells, SGit and PKI, SHarness and VoiceDebrief.

why.line: Odoo 20 agents create and update records from automated and scheduled actions, with a native MCP server.
why.para: Agents now execute in many small companies' system of record.

gap.line: Power comes from tools and the user behind them; approvals are per agent; conversations last 30 days.
gap.para: The gap every agent platform has.

abp.line: A behaviour policy per Odoo agent: grant, mandate, gap and barrier; Odoo's access rights are the boundary.
abp.para: An Odoo module could measure the grant automatically.

cell.line: An Odoo cell on AgentiCCells' ladder, from one workflow at £500 to a network at £20,000.
cell.para: The factory can make sites that read from Odoo.

apply.line: Agents plan in a vault, a person signs, a broker applies through the API, and the record lasts.

more.line: SHarness around the Odoo server, VoiceDebrief into the CRM, PrompTugal.news with local businesses.

plan.line: A demo, the broker pattern, the offer, and Odoo partners as the channel.

watch.line: Odoo moves fast; external API plan gates; legacy RPC deprecated in favour of JSON-2.

limits.line: A strategy, an illustrative policy, some details from integrators, third-party customer numbers.

sources.line: Odoo's release notes, integrators' summaries, Odoo's documentation, and earlier articles.
